notes: Run in a Claude Code session in the Format repo. Graders read the session's file edits, commands and final report. Expected behaviours are observable in the diff, the command output or the report.

evals.name: new-command-reaches-every-door
evals.prompt: Add a command to Format that duplicates a chat (copies its visible messages into a new conversation with ' (copy)' after the title) and make sure agents can use it too.
expected_behavior: The director routes to engine-builder: an @command conversation.duplicate (or similar) is added in backend/app/engine/cmd_conversation.py with typed params and a description naming what it returns
backend/app/agent_guide.py gains a verb_noun tool name with a 'Use when' sentence, and ./format agents sync is run, regenerating references/tools.md
The command is exercised through POST /api/commands and the CLI; backend/HASHOUT_LOG.md gains an entry; no sed or scripted edit is used on repo files

evals.name: window-change-measured-for-shift
evals.prompt: Show the number of runs next to each scheduled task in the Scheduled list.
expected_behavior: ui-builder is loaded; the change edits frontend/src/ui/scheduled-view.ts with a setText on an existing keyed row rather than rebuilding the list
The count sits where its width changes cannot move other elements (inside the left-aligned text block)
A throttled browser check reports layout shift 0 with sources recorded and no page errors before the work is called done

evals.name: use-not-build
evals.prompt: Ask Claude in Format to summarize README.md and publish the summary as a page.
expected_behavior: The director classifies this as use, not build: no repo file is edited
It uses chat.send then chat.wait (or the MCP tools send_message and wait_for_reply) and artifact.publish into the same conversation
The report gives the conversation id and the artifact id and version

evals.name: release-cut
evals.prompt: Cut a patch release for the fix we just made.
expected_behavior: release-keeper bumps the version in backend/app/__init__.py, frontend/src/version.ts, frontend/package.json and both package-lock fields to the same value
Commits are authored as nodemode-ai with Conventional Commit subjects and end with the session trailers; an annotated tag v[x.y.z] is on HEAD
CHANGELOG has the new entry and the parity tracker still has exactly two rows
